_comment: Harness case H-COL-004: Recovery suggestion generated by the collector diagnostics module when a source returns fewer candidates than its historical baseline. Includes structured evidence (baseline stats vs current run) and actionable suggestions for the operator.

recovery_suggestion.title: Low candidate yield from source 'rss-eurogamer'
recovery_suggestion.summary: Source returned only 3 candidates, which is 87.5% below its 30-day rolling median of 24. The fetch itself succeeded (HTTP 200), so the feed is reachable but its content volume has dropped sharply.
suggested_actions: Manually visit https://www.eurogamer.net/feed in a browser to confirm the feed is still active and publishing expected content.
Check whether the feed URL has changed (e.g., Eurogamer may have migrated to a new feed host or format). Compare against the official Eurogamer RSS page.
Review the raw fetch payload for this run to see if a site redesign or paywall banner is trimming the feed output.
If the low count is confirmed as the new normal, update the source's expected_candidate_range in config/sources.yaml to avoid future false-positive warnings.
If the feed is permanently deprecated, mark it as inactive in the source registry and add a replacement source.
